title: Baccano! Bangai-hen
justification: AniList 3901 (SPECIAL, 3 episode(s) from 2008-02-27) is AniDB 4897's special(s) S1-S3, aired 2008-02-27 to 2008-05-28. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 4897. overlay/4897.json (already present) puts S1-S3 on TVDB 0x1-0x3 'Graham Specter's Love and Peace', 'The Delinquents That Arrive at the High-Class Neighborhood Are the Same as Always', 'Carol Realizes That the Story Cannot Have an Ending'.
